product-manager.label: Product Manager
product-manager.description: Owns product strategy and execution; needs experimentation literacy, customer insight, tech strategy, and communication.

data-scientist.label: Data Scientist
data-scientist.description: Builds statistical and ML models end-to-end; needs modeling depth, causal inference, and production awareness.

data-engineer.label: Data Engineer
data-engineer.description: Builds data pipelines and platforms; needs SQL/ETL, distributed computing, and BI tooling.

ml-engineer.label: Machine Learning Engineer
ml-engineer.description: Ships ML systems to production; needs deep ML theory, deep learning, and scalable computing.

marketing-analyst.label: Marketing Analyst / Marketing Data Scientist
marketing-analyst.description: Drives marketing decisions with data; needs experimentation, consumer insight, pricing, and segmentation methods.

consultant.label: Analytics Consultant / Strategy
consultant.description: Advises clients using analytics; needs problem framing, influence, and communication.

finance-quant.label: Finance / Quantitative Analyst
finance-quant.description: Applies analytics to financial decisions; needs forecasting, behavioral finance, and risk modeling.

operations-supply-chain.label: Operations / Supply Chain Analyst
operations-supply-chain.description: Optimizes operations and supply chains; needs forecasting, inventory models, and prescriptive analytics.

healthcare-analyst.label: Healthcare Analytics
healthcare-analyst.description: Analytics for health systems and policy; needs decision modeling and cost-effectiveness methods.

fraud-risk-analyst.label: Fraud / Risk Analyst
fraud-risk-analyst.description: Detects fraud and manages risk with ML; needs anomaly detection and feature engineering on messy data.
